visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Intro phase. A young boy in a dark blue t-shirt and a woman in a white tank top sit behind a round table. The boy holds up three fingers while pointing at three boxes labeled 'PIANO'. The setting is a brightly lit indoor living room with a brown sofa in the background. (2) Unboxing phase. The pair unbox a purple foldable keyboard. The boy presses the white and black keys. A screen overlay shows a graphic of the product with its price. (3) Testing phase. Close-up shots of the woman's hands playing a fast-paced melody on the keys. The keyboard is placed on a round wooden table. (4) Second product review. The boy holds a black roll-up piano. A text overlay shows the price NT$350. (5) Side-by-side comparison. A split-screen effect shows the woman playing the keyboard with 'Opened' and 'Not Opened' text indicators. (6) Third product review. They demonstrate another 88-key black roll-up piano with thicker keys. (7) Conclusion and Credits. The duo claps their hands in a synchronized rhythm while credit text scrolls vertically over the screen background.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A woman with long brown hair wearing a white tank top and a boy wearing glasses and a dark blue t-shirt.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: An indoor living room with a large brown fabric sofa and a light-colored wall. A round wooden table sits in front of the sofa.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Opening phase starts with a cheerful, mid-tempo acoustic BGM. A woman's energetic voice and a boy's voice provide rapid-fire introductions in Mandarin. (2) Product testing phase features clear electronic piano notes sounding as keys are pressed. The BGM remains steady in the background. (3) Transition occurs with a digital 'whoosh' SFX. The vocal tone becomes more analytical as they describe features. (4) Demonstration phase. Higher-pitched piano scales are heard during key testing. Occasional laughter from the speakers is mixed in. (5) Outro phase concludes with the BGM transitioning to a rhythmic piano and guitar melody. Rhythmic hand-clapping sounds are added, synchronized with the music beat. Vocals fade out gradually.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Intro -> Review Product 1 -> Review Product 2 -> Review Product 3 -> Comparative Summary.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to provide a side-by-side comparison of three different portable and affordable electronic pianos. By testing their touch sensitivity, sound quality, and portability, the creators help viewers determine which budget option is best suited for beginners or as a travel practice tool.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video features unboxing and explicit price listings of multiple models of a specific product type (roll-up pianos).

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a parent-child dynamic to make product reviews more engaging and accessible for a family-oriented audience.
